Open cost calculator Frequently asked questions How much does a retaining wall cost on the Gold Coast? On the Gold Coast, retaining walls typically range from around $250 to $800 per square metre depending on the material, height, site access and whether engineering is required. Timber sleeper walls are usually at the lower end, while concrete, block and stone walls sit higher due to labour and engineering needs. These figures usually include materials and labour but not council approvals or complex excavation. Do I need council approval for a retaining wall in Gold Coast City?
